title: 又……又…… (not only… but also…)
longExplanation: not only… but also…. Pinyin: yòu…… yòu……

examples.romanization: zhège xīguā yòu dà yòu tián。
examples.translation: This watermelon is big and sweet.

title: V1 + 着 + V2 (V1-ing while V2-ing)
longExplanation: V1-ing while V2-ing. Pinyin: V1 + zhe + V2

examples.romanization: dìdi chī zhe píngguǒ xiě zuòyè。
examples.translation: The younger brother is doing homework while eating [an] apple.

examples.sentence: 昨天吃了感冒药，现在好一些了。
examples.romanization: zuótiān chī le gǎnmàoyào， xiànzài hǎo yīxiē le。
examples.translation: I took flu medicine yesterday, and I’m better now.

title: V 了 ((didn’t V but) now V)
longExplanation: (didn’t V but) now V. Pinyin: V le

examples.sentence: 现在我可以穿漂亮的裙子了。
examples.romanization: xiànzài wǒ kěyǐ chuān piàoliang de qúnzi le。
examples.translation: Now I can wear a beautiful dress.

title: 越来越 + A + (了) (more and more A)
longExplanation: more and more A. Pinyin: yuèláiyuè + A + ( le)

examples.translation: You’re more and more handsome these days.

title: V + 得 + RESULT (can V to RESULT)
longExplanation: can V to RESULT. Pinyin: V + dé + RESULT

examples.romanization: wǒ kàn dé qīngchu nàge hànzì。
examples.translation: I can see the Chinese character clearly.

title: V + 得 + DIRECTION (can V to DIRECTION)
longExplanation: can V to DIRECTION. Pinyin: V + dé + DIRECTION

examples.romanization: lóu zhème gāo， nǐ shàng dé lái ma？
examples.translation: The building is so high, are you able to come up?

title: V + 不 + result (cannot V to RESULT)
longExplanation: cannot V to RESULT. Pinyin: V + bù + result

examples.translation: I can't seek out a good restaurant.

title: V + 不 + direction (cannot V to DIRECTION)
longExplanation: cannot V to DIRECTION. Pinyin: V + bù + direction

examples.romanization: lóu tài gāo le， wǒ shàng bù qù。
examples.translation: The building is too high, I can't go up.

title: N 呢? (where is N?)
longExplanation: where is N?. Pinyin: N ne?

examples.translation: The son just finished his homework.
My son is doing homework moments ago.

title: V + 了 + DURATION + O (V’ed O for DURATION)
longExplanation: V’ed O for DURATION. Pinyin: V + le + DURATION + O

examples.sentence: 我们坐了一个小时公共汽车。
examples.romanization: wǒmen zuò le yī gè xiǎoshí gōnggòngqìchē。
examples.translation: We took a bus for an hour.

pattern: V + 了 + DURATION + O + 了
title: V + 了 + DURATION + O + 了 (have been V-ing O for DURATION)
shortExplanation: have been V-ing O for DURATION
longExplanation: have been V-ing O for DURATION. Pinyin: V + le + DURATION + O + le

examples.romanization: wǒ xuéxí le yī nián Hànyǔ le。
examples.translation: I have studied Chinese for a year.

pattern: 对 N 感兴趣/有兴趣
title: 对 N 感兴趣/有兴趣 (interested in N)
longExplanation: interested in N. Pinyin: duì N gǎnxìngqù/ yǒuxìngqù

examples.sentence: 他们对中国电影感兴趣。
examples.translation: They are interested in Chinese movies.
